Test Quarkus REST abstract resources with `@Path`

Triggered by https://github.com/quarkusio/quarkus/pull/41606

PASS: `mvn clean verify -f http/http-advanced-reactive -Dit.test=HttpAdvancedReactiveIT -Dquarkus.platform.version=3.12.2`
FAIL: `mvn clean verify -f http/http-advanced-reactive -Dit.test=HttpAdvancedReactiveIT -Dquarkus.platform.version=3.12.1 -Dreruns=0`

Merge into branches is ATM blocked by https://github.com/quarkusio/quarkus/issues/42977
